column1: Steps from GitHub Documentation:
You can follow the steps below to sign artifacts in GitHub actions. The trick involves loading in your private key into GitHub Actions using the gpg command-line commands.
Export your gpg private key from the system that you have created it.
Find your key-id (using gpg --list-secret-keys --keyid-format=long)
Export the gpg secret key to an ASCII file using gpg --export-secret-keys -a <key-id> > secret.txt
Edit secret.txt using a plain text editor
column2: and replace all newlines with a literal ""\n"" until everything is on a single line

column1: Set up GitHub Actions secrets
